game_concept: A tower defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Broken Colonnade, a row of broken columns: the relic hunter must hold off stone sentinels while practicing lists. Core idea – Backpack Append: Use append and remove to manage the relic hunter's backpack list as stone sentinels drop loot.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Broken Colonnade: a row of broken columns
core_gameplay_loop: In Broken Colonnade, repeat each round: Use append and remove to manage the relic hunter's backpack list as stone sentinels drop loot. Then check bag_space and advance.
player_objective: Protect the rune gate from stone sentinels in Broken Colonnade: keep bag_space above zero until the 24-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 1 (intro tier): Backpack Append
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 7, Level 1, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
